postconditions.satisfied_by: Attempted live perturbation ground-truth capture against Monza (Italy) RBR 2023 Q via the DB-backed telemetry store (store=C:/Programs/f1Brainz/data/telemetry_store.db, read-only, absolute main-checkout path). Session load succeeded in ~7s: rho=1.1480283106796993 (real measured Monza air density), quali_mass(2023)=808.0 (matches longitudinal_fit.MASS_KG exactly). The full perturbation-arm re-fit (mass+/-, rho+/-, thetaR lo/hi) then stalled with near-zero CPU utilization across two independent bounded attempts (~10min and ~4min, confirmed via Get-Process CPU sampling showing ~0.15-0.19s accumulated over each window) inside per-driver smoother-HP calibration -- most plausibly explained by contention from other concurrently-running agents in this session on the shared main-checkout telemetry files (6+ other Ship agents active per the team roster), not a defect in the DB-store approach (which itself completed fast). FALLBACK invoked per handoff's explicit sanction: derived THETA_SENS_CDA_REL, RHO_SENS_PMAX_REL, THETA_SENS_PMAX_REL algebraically from the pre-existing documented reference already in estimate_store.py's SYSTEMATIC_FLOOR comments (measured 4.3% CdA, 3.7% P_max, from an earlier canonical nuisance_sensitivity.py run on this same session) minus the exact analytic mass(1:1)/rho(CdA:-1:1) quadrature terms. Verified: systematic_budget()'s analytic total at the REAL measured mass_kg=808/rho=1.148028 reproduces 4.3000%/3.7000% exactly (by construction). Full derivation math and a manual-only live-perturbation harness (tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_systematic_budget_monza_validation.py::run_live_monza_perturbation_validation, guarded to never run under pytest collection) are documented for a future rerun once environment contention is not a factor.
